title: Everyday obedience — six-week block
desc: Recall, settle, loose-lead walking and a reliable stop. Suitable for dogs over six months. Six weekly sessions.

title: Puppy foundations — four-week block
desc: For puppies 10–20 weeks. Socialisation done properly, handling, lead introduction and the household habits that matter later.

title: Livestock worrying — one-day workshop
desc: For dogs that chase, and for owners who live near stock and would rather never find out. Theory in the morning, controlled practical work in the afternoon.
